title: Select existing cross-family regression tests from touched shared state transitions
outcome: The existing focused-test tooling selects relevant cross-family scenarios from the shared transitions a change touches, so seam regressions are exercised before review without a hand-maintained test list or another gate.
acceptance: A change touching shared sync transitions automatically includes the existing scenarios covering their cross-family interactions in the focused selection
The known baseline-admission, withheld-retirement and local-revert seam cases are selected without the author manually naming them
The rule adds no gate and changes neither the review pair nor the full validation requirement
